To find the root of $f(x),$ we must solve $f(x)=0:$

$$
9\sqrt[7]{2x-6}-9=0
$$

We solve this equation by making $x$ the subject, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}9\sqrt[7]{2x-6}-9 & =0 \\ 9\sqrt[7]{2x-6} & =9 \\ \sqrt[7]{2x-6} & =1 \\ (\sqrt[7]{2x-6})^{7} & ={1}^{7} \\ 2x-6 & =1 \\ 2x & =7 \\ x & =\frac{7}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the root of $f(x)$ is $x=\frac{7}{2}.$
